Results.ReviewText:
Packaging - MUCH better than almost anything I've ever received.  Only one piece of Styrofoam in the whole thing, excellent use of various forms of cardboard protected the grill very well.

Product build quality -  much better than average instructions, all the bolt holes lined up.  I had it built in ~2 hrs. with no help.  grill is plenty strong without weighing a ton.

Easy to use - neither my wife nor I have had any problems using the grill - minor hot spots, easy enough to figure out.  It cooks well - and gets plenty hot to sear/brown food

Overall - very happy we bought a Weber grill - would do so again - and recommend the brand to all our friends.
Results.Title: Weber grills are worth the extra $$

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
